% 22.05.2023 Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.

1.  This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.402/2019 registered at PS Dayalpur under Sections 420/467/468/471/34 IPC on grounds of settlement between the parties dated 06th April,
2023 which is on record of this Court.
The petitioner Nos.1-3 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in Court and duly identified by the counsels and the IO.

Respondent No.2 states that she has no objection to the quashing of the FIR as she has received all the amounts which have been stated for settlement in the MoU.
2.

Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 21:42:08 the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.402/2019 registered at PS Dayalpur under Sections 420/467/468/471/34 IPC and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
3. Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
4. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
Pending applications (if any) are disposed of as infructuous.
5. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
